rules.description: Joint standing committees must notify the Sergeant-at-Arms of a public hearing at least ten days before it is held.
rules.source: Massachusetts General Court, Joint Rule 1D, as amended June 26, 2025: "Notification to the Sergeant-at-Arms for public hearings conducted shall not be less than 10 days prior to the time of such meetings." https://malegislature.gov/Laws/Rules/Joint
rules.measures: The rule runs on the date a committee notified the Sergeant-at-Arms. The Legislature does not publish that date, and this archive does not hold it. first_seen records when this platform first observed a hearing page, which is a different event and can only ever be later than the notification. A bounded first_seen therefore supports a claim about what was observable on the website, not a finding about the rule itself.
rules.exceptions: Joint Rule 1D lets the ten-day requirement be suspended in an emergency by recorded vote of the committee. The site does not publish those votes, so a page failing this test may still be compliant.
